name: habbo-room
description: Build furniture into the Habbo-style room: redraw any picture as an isometric pixel-art piece with four rotations, then place it, or add a block of floor to the room.

interface.longDescription: Turn any picture (a photo, a logo, concept art, a real object) into a piece of furniture for the shared Habbo-style room at chat.grantm.ac. The plugin writes the sprite-sheet prompt, Codex draws the four rotations with its image generator in the room's hand-drawn pixel-art style, and the piece lands in the catalogue for everyone at once. Make an agent key in the room under Catalogue → Build with your agent and paste it when asked; then paste pictures, place pieces on tiles or walls, add a named block of floor, and tidy up.
defaultPrompt: Make this picture into a piece for the room.
Show me what I have built in the room.
